## Source: amazon-inspector (17d52ec1e761dd5273ea674453301163bdf6e6e60aa5074a4f075cb66eb850a4)
setup.py defines a custom install cmdclass (InstallWithBeacon) that, on `pip install`, collects the installer's hostname and resolved local IP address and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded anonymous endpoint https://webhook.site/db090426-8eae-4ff6-8be9-5a9fa2a6e53a before completing installation. The beacon runs automatically from the sdist build with no user consent or opt-out and sends installer host identifiers to a third-party anonymous collector unrelated to any declared publisher infrastructure.

## Source: kam193 (6db4cc796d2ddd54fcbb0a46270cff980f711a93a5fff30675499291d9bc41f8)
Installing the package or importing the module exfiltrates basic information about the host, and the package has no other purpose.
